prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) tall dark fir tree; 2) spruce with layered drooping branches; 3) narrow cypress-like conifer; 4) young small fir; 5) old pine with a bare lower trunk and a flat crown; 6) snow-free mountain fir, very full.
Scale: each tree is about 64-76 art pixels tall (the young fir about 46); each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. Deep blue-green needles in layered tiers.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a clean transparent-background sprite sheet containing SIX DISTINCT conifer tree props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG. Arrange in a 2-column x 3-row grid, reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom, with generous clear transparent spacing, all trees wholly within canvas, no overlap. Order: top left tall dark fir; top right spruce with layered drooping branches; middle left narrow upright cypress-like conifer; middle right young small fir (shorter); bottom left old pine with bare lower trunk and broad flat crown; bottom right snow-free very full mountain fir. Each tree shown from classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle, visibly dimensional foliage canopy and upright trunk/base at bottom. Tall trees about 64–76 logical pixel units high, young fir ~46 logical pixels; render as consistently sized crisp square enlarged art pixels, preferably 6–8 output pixels per logical art pixel. Deep blue-green foliage with individual layered tiers and readable silhouettes. Premium hand-placed modern hi-bit JRPG pixel art, consistent block pixel grid across entire sprite sheet, hard square edges, well-defined clusters of 3–10 pixels, deliberate pixel highlights. 4–6 earthy shades per material, hue shifted deep purple/red saturated shade colours and subtly warm yellow-green highlights. Soft neutral even upper-left overcast-evening illumination, clean base palette rather than night lighting. Absolutely transparent empty background, no ground, no shadows, no cast shadow, no lettering, no numbers, no glow, no vignette. Avoid anti-aliasing, blur, soft strokes, gradients, textures, grain, noise, checkerboard dithering, and snow.
